propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Da, quaesumus, omnipotens Deus: ut beatorum Martyrum tuorum Hippolyti et
Cassiani veneranda solemnitas, et devotionem nobis augeat, et salutem. Per
Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in
unitate.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Respice, Domine, munera populi tui, Sanctorum festivitate votiva: et tuae
testificatio veritatis nobis proficiat ad salutem. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A pre-1955 lay hand missal, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its rubrics, its seasonal second and third orations, its Holy Week and its sanctoral are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

The commemoration begins at the foot of leaf n648, printed p. 640, where this file already records its Collect; its Secret and Postcommunion stand at the head of leaf n649, printed p. 641, running head `14th AUGUST`. The Secret is set with no Latin cue; it answers `Respice, Domine, munera populi tui`. Page-image collation confirms that this historical English body answers the complete target Latin identity; publication is limited to the 1861 wording and does not claim that Cummiskey appoints the 1962 celebration.
